I saved the draft to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and told Anselm in his DM. Nothing has been sent; someone still has to review and send it.

The draft's subject is "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". The body gives the $2,101 per-seat figure Marcus provided and says Anselm approved sharing it.

Anselm is the CFO, and finance figures can go to people outside the finance and account-owner group only with his or June's approval. His message in this DM is that approval, so I didn't need to request another one. Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so Ruth's approval for outside mail didn't apply.
